module.Title: World Challenge: Mine a Rock
module.Teaching: Combine a List check, removal, and resource reward into one reusable method.
module.PredictionExplanation: The check prevents rewarding a rock that was not present.
module.DebugPrompt: Mining should remove the rock and increase the collected resource count.
module.RecallPrompt: Rebuild MineRock from memory. Use these exact identifiers: Contains, Remove, rocks, stoneCount.
module.TransferPrompt: Create DefeatEnemy that removes an enemy and adds one coin. Use these exact identifiers: Contains, coinCount, enemies.
module.PreviewMessage: The world collection and inventory reward now work together.
